study.question: Can an action-value-blind encoding of the four supplied task masks recover the incumbent click AUC, distinguishing extra code information from an explicit representation path for already supplied feedback?
study.hypothesis: The inherited model uses action embeddings in primary scoring and detailed summaries but collapses task masks to the cart/fav/buy union for routing. The negative constant and broad-permutation trajectories may reflect removal or disruption of an explicit representation of mask information. A full mask signature routed through the existing action table may recover click quality without reading action values. Exact conditional information utility remains unidentified unless the host also establishes the action-vocabulary/signature relation. Observations: g2-r0078-full_action_replay and g2-r0079-full_action_control replay the incumbent AUC 0.6689610675617089 exactly at the same seed; these are reproducibility checks, not independent repetitions. g2-r0078-action_blind_constant AUC 0.6433040120460289 is negative evidence for collapsing the action input to one token under the inherited recipe, not proof of information unavailable in task masks. g2-r0078-action_permuted_retrained and g2-r0079-all_valid_bridge AUC 0.6624208034892454; g2-r0078-action_permuted_eval_only AUC 0.6558015771863462. Retraining partially recovers the evaluation-only loss, so distribution disruption is consequential. g2-r0079-auxiliary_union_permuted AUC 0.6631724257525596 retains coarse auxiliary mask compatibility but does not preserve all four bits. g2-r0079-task_signature_permuted matches full-action AUC, all task metrics and reported slices exactly. Changed-code support was not requested, so this could be an identity intervention rather than an informative null. Pinned loader lines383-408 constructs action_task_table from action token names; lines539-541 derives four masks from the same historical action IDs and valid-history mask. This proves action-to-mask dependence, not mask-to-action injectivity. No released action vocabulary or raw parquet is exposed here; table size and injectivity are unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Three standalone variants: byte-identical full_action_control, mask_signature_canonical, and mask_signature_affine. The latter two ignore every historical action value and encode signature click+2*cart+4*fav+8*buy at each valid event into the existing action embedding table. Canonical uses the first16 metadata-declared nonspecial rows; affine uses the bijection (5*s+3)%16 over the same rows. Constructor fails explicitly if fewer than16 nonspecial rows exist; this is an unverified prerequisite, not an assertion about unavailable vocabularies. Never resize the table, hash collisions, read raw vocab/data, alter masks or fall back to real codes. Padding and target indices remain0. All three use the same module graph and allocation. This tests an explicit mask-representation path and sufficiency of this implementation, not total feedback removal or formal conditional independence.
predictions: Host prerequisite: at least16 nonspecial action rows, expected unchanged parameter counts32192421 total/31793216 embedding/399205 dense from ancestor receipt; verify actual counts rather than infer from source alone.

At fixed states, both mask-only variants must be invariant to changing raw action values with all masks and other inputs fixed. Both must have zero history output on empty histories, unchanged item fields/masks, valid target zero, and finite four-task forward/backward under host BF16. Every one of16 signatures maps injectively to a nonspecial row.

If mask information is sufficient through this path, both assignments should substantially recover the 0.0256570555 AUC gap from the previous constant treatment and approach full-action AUC. Predeclare descriptive near-recovery as absolute click AUC gap<=0.001 for each assignment; report raw gaps and paired user-cluster intervals if available, never call this a formal equivalence test.
If gains appear only under one assignment, row initialization/Adagrad visitation and optimization are consequential alternatives. Identical same-seed replay is not seed robustness.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, counts for history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64, and measured inference throughput, whole-batch p50/p95, memory and train/validation wall or allocated GPU seconds. Do not compare equal epoch cost as if equal compute.
falsifiers: Fewer than16 nonspecial rows, non-bijective mapping, any raw action dependence, changed masks/item fields/target action, failed masking/backward or changed inherited source invalidate the proposed substitution before performance interpretation. Record failure and its actual charged cost; no silent fallback.

Both admissible mask-only assignments remaining >0.001 below replay reject near-recovery for this implementation and recipe. This alone does not prove residual information beyond masks; vocabulary many-to-one structure, row assignment and optimization remain unresolved.

Near-recovery in both assignments weakens a claim that original action values are necessary beyond supplied masks under this recipe. Exact redundancy requires inspecting/auditing the actual authorized vocabulary or training-only signature/action contingency, which is not currently available.

Full-action replay disagreeing with the accepted same-seed receipt requires an integrity investigation before attribution. Equality of rounded AUC is insufficient; compare all task metrics/checkpoints where host evidence permits.
alternative_explanations: Mask signatures may not determine action IDs: aliases, unknown tokens, exposure or feedback types outside the four tasks could collapse distinct codes. No injectivity is inferred from the loader or equal permutation metrics.

Signature recoding changes which randomly initialized table row receives each event, per-row Adagrad accumulation and active table usage. Two fixed bijections probe but do not eliminate this confound or substitute for paired seeds.

The original model exposes only auxiliary-union mask routing to its primary paths, whereas the substitute explicitly exposes all four bits to those paths. Recovery establishes practical mask sufficiency through this encoding; it does not isolate every pathway.
The inherited surrogate context gradients, BatchNorm/Dice statistics and one-pass optimization may amplify input recoding. No training-loss or gradient mechanism changes are proposed.

official_offline delayed feedback maturity, released whole-window vocabularies, auxiliary category/brand24h matching and validation reuse bound applicability; no production point-in-time, advertisement-specific conversion or test-set claim.
